arxiv-2105-02393.description: Abstract The original Finite Selection Model (FSM) was developed in the 1970s to enhance the design of the RAND Health Insurance Experiment (HIE; Newhouse et al. 1993 ). At the time of its development by Carl Morris ( Morris 1979 ) , there were fundamental computational limitations to make the method widely available for practitioners.

arxiv-2209-05500.title: Ultra-Diffuse Galaxies as Extreme Star-forming Environments II: Star Formation and Pressure Balance in H I-Rich UDGs Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , SciPy ( jon 2001 ) , the IPython package ( Pérez & Granger 2007 ) , NumPy ( Van
arxiv-2209-05500.creator: Erin Kado-Fong, Chang-Goo Kim, Jenny E. Greene, Lachlan Lancaster
arxiv-2209-05500.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Erin Kado-Fong, Chang-Goo Kim, Jenny E. Greene, Lachlan Lancaster. In addition to occupying the extreme, diffuse tail of the dwarf galaxy population, Ultra-Diffuse Galaxies (UDGs) are themselves a key laboratory in which to study star formation in extreme low-density environments. In the second paper of this series, we compare the spatially resolved star formation activity of 22 H I-selected UDGs and 21 “normal” dwarf galaxies within 120 Mpc to predictions within the pressure-regulated, feedback-modulated (PRFM) theory of star formation.

arxiv-2404-02429.title: AD4RL: Autonomous Driving Benchmarks for Offline Reinforcement Learning with Value-based Dataset
arxiv-2404-02429.creator: Dongsu Lee, Chanin Eom, Minhae Kwon
arxiv-2404-02429.description: Abstract Offline reinforcement learning has emerged as a promising technology by enhancing its practicality through the use of pre-collected large datasets. Despite its practical benefits, most algorithm development research in offline reinforcement learning still relies on game tasks with synthetic datasets. To address such limitations, this paper provides autonomous driving datasets and benchmarks for offline reinforcement learning research.

arxiv-2410-13396.title: Linguistically Grounded Analysis of Language Models using Shapley Head Values
arxiv-2410-13396.creator: Marcell Fekete, Johannes Bjerva
arxiv-2410-13396.description: Abstract Understanding how linguistic knowledge is encoded in language models is crucial for improving their generalisation capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the processing of morphosyntactic phenomena, by leveraging a recently proposed method for probing language models via Shapley Head Values (SHVs).

pmc-10645134.creator: Eva Rivas, Manuel López-Baamonde, Josep Sanahuja, Elena Del Rio, Tomeu Ramis, Anna Recasens, Antonio López, Marilyn Arias, Stylianos Kampakis, Timo Lauteslager, Osama Awara, Edward J. Mascha, Alex Soriano, Joan Ramon Badía, Pedro Castro, Daniel I. Sessler
pmc-10645134.description: BackgroundTachypnea is among the earliest signs of pulmonary decompensation. Contactless continuous respiratory rate monitoring might be useful in isolated COVID-19 patients admitted in wards. We therefore aimed to determine whether continuous monitoring of respiratory patterns in hospitalized patients with COVID-19 predicts subsequent need for increased respiratory support.

pmc-10736449.title: CORPORATE PERSPECTIVES OF A NATIONAL NURSING HOME PRAGMATIC TRIAL AND FACTORS AFFECTING IMPLEMENTATION FIDELITY
pmc-10736449.creator: Jacy Weems, Ellen McCreedy, Grace Wittenberg, Rosa Baier
pmc-10736449.description: Implementation fidelity is concerning for embedded pragmatic clinical trials (ePCTs), where effectiveness is evaluated in real-world settings instead of a structured clinical environment. Healthcare facilities paused ePCT research activities during the COVID-19 pandemic to address related staffing issues and infections.

pmc-10764820.title: Simulated virtual on-call training programme for improving non-specialised junior doctors' confidence in out-of-hours psychiatry: quantitative assessment
pmc-10764820.creator: Helen Blamey, Charlotte H Harrison, Alistair Roddick, Tina Malhotra, Kate E A Saunders
pmc-10764820.description: Aims and methodTo investigate whether a psychiatry-specific virtual on-call training programme improved confidence of junior trainees in key areas of psychiatry practice. The programme comprised one 90 min lecture and a 2 h simulated on-call shift where participants were bleeped to complete a series of common on-call tasks, delivered via Microsoft Teams.

pmc-11476258.title: The Potential Related Genes and Mechanisms Involved in Improving the Treadmill Exercise Ability of APP/PS1 Mice
pmc-11476258.creator: Zhe Zhao, Xingqing Wu, Weijia Wu, Yingzhe Tang, Xiangyuan Meng, Mei Peng, Changfa Tang, Lan Zheng, Wenfeng Liu
pmc-11476258.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) causes a decline in skeletal muscle function, which can further exacerbate the cognitive dysfunction of patients with AD. It has been widely established that exercise improves AD brain pathology, but the role of skeletal muscle in AD is still poorly understood.

pmc-11716114.title: Critical Modifying Effect of APOE 4 Allele and Sex on the Prospective Associations between Lipid Species and 10‐year Cognitive Decline in Biracial Community‐dwelling Older Adults: the Chicago Health and Aging Project (CHAP)
pmc-11716114.creator: Ted KS Ng, Todd Beck, Xiaoran Liu, Pankaja Desai, Thomas Monroe Holland, Klodian Dhana, Kristin R Krueger, Robert S Wilson, Denis A Evans, Kumar B Rajan
pmc-11716114.description: BackgroundThere have been contradictory findings on the associations between lipids and cognitive decline, which could have been attributed to heterogeneity in APOE allele and sex.MethodWe analyzed a subset of the Chicago Health and Aging Project, comprising 3,496 biracial community‐dwelling older adults (58% African American & 64% women; mean follow‐up=4.6 years) with lipid panel and longitudinal cognitive tests.

pmc-12440168.title: Human papillomavirus genomes associate with active host chromatin during persistent viral infection
pmc-12440168.creator: Alix Warburton, Tovah E. Markowitz, JJ L. Miranda, Kinjal Majumder, Alison A. McBride, Cary Moody, Cary Moody, Cary Moody, Cary Moody
pmc-12440168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) maintain their genomes as minichromosomes in the nuclei of infected keratinocytes. This study investigates the association of HPV31 genomes with host chromatin using both HiC and 4C-seq chromosome conformation capture techniques. We show that HPV31 genomes preferentially associate with transcriptionally active A compartments of host chromatin, regions of open chromatin defined by ATAC-seq, and super-enhancers defined by Brd4 and H3K27ac ChIP-seq.

pmc-13074315.title: Ultrasound-Assisted Extraction of Polyphenols from Hericium erinaceus: Optimization, Bioactivities and LC-MS-Based Chemical Profiling
pmc-13074315.creator: Hongfei Liu, Cong Zhao, Shuyue Pang, Yuting Shu, Lina Chen, Jing Wang, Helong Bai
pmc-13074315.description: In this study, the Box–Behnken Design (BBD) was adopted to optimize the ultrasound-assisted extraction (UAE) conditions of polyphenols from Hericium erinaceus (H. erinaceus) on the basis of single-factor experiments, with extraction time, solid–liquid ratio and ethanol concentration as the key investigation factors. The optimal extraction parameters were determined as follows: extraction time of 56.85 min, solid–liquid ratio of 1:56.

pmc-13172185.title: Efgartigimod in Patients with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Refractory or Intolerant to IVIg
pmc-13172185.creator: Flora D’Amico, Sofia Campo, Nicasio Rini, Claudia Vinciguerra, Liliana Bevilacqua, Carmen Erra, Paolo Barone, Francesco Tuccillo, Francesco Habetswallner, Filippo Brighina, Vincenzo Di Stefano
pmc-13172185.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionGeneralized myasthenia gravis (gMG) is a rare chronic autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction caused by pathogenic autoantibodies directed against a postsynaptic target. The therapeutic landscape of gMG has recently expanded with the introduction of FcRn inhibitors. This study aimed to assess the real-world effectiveness and safety of efgartigimod (EFG) in AChR-positive gMG patients who failed or were intolerant to intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg).MethodsEFG was administered as four consecutive weekly intravenous infusions at 10 mg/kg.

pmc-13181947.title: Simulation-based feedback systems in cardiopulmonary resuscitation training: a scoping review
pmc-13181947.creator: Mahdieh Sabery, Zahra Batooli, Ebrahim Sabbarifard, Faezeh Ghaffari
pmc-13181947.description: BackgroundSudden cardiac arrest is among the leading causes of death worldwide and continues to be a public health issue. The quality of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) which relates to the depth, rate, and full recoil of chest compressions, is critical to return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC) and survival.

pmc-13342579.title: Multi-trait GWAS reveals divergent local and polygenic architecture of cardiovascular traits across African and European ancestries in the UK Biobank
pmc-13342579.creator: Musalula Sinkala, Samar Elsheikh, Mamana Mbiyavanga, Joshua Cullinan, Nicola Mulder
pmc-13342579.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The genetic architecture of cardiovascular traits is poorly characterised in non-European populations, limiting our understanding of disease aetiology and contributing to health disparities. Here, we analyse the genetic architecture of four cardiovascular traits (systolic and diastolic blood pressure, pulse rate, and maximum heart rate) using multi-trait analysis of genome-wide association studies and local genetic correlation analysis in 459,327 European (EUR) and 6654 African (AFR) ancestry individuals from the UK Biobank.

pmc-13361730.title: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis secondary to nasopharyngeal abscess with Klebsiella pneumoniae infection in an elderly patient with multiple comorbidities: a case report and literature review
pmc-13361730.creator: Yujun Wu, Daojie Huang, Liyan Gu, Yongqiu Zhang, Jie Wei
pmc-13361730.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCerebral venous sinus thrombosis (CVST) is a rare but severe cerebrovascular disorder. While often associated with hypercoagulable states, infections, particularly those involving the head and neck region, can be a significant predisposing factor.

pmc-13371670.title: Mpox knowledge, attitudes toward Mpox vaccine and hesitancy for Mpox vaccination among teachers in Kenya
pmc-13371670.creator: Patrick M. Mutua, Michael M. Gicheru, Joshua Mutiso, Erick K. Serem
pmc-13371670.description: BackgroundSixteen African countries, including Kenya, reported Mpox cases over a two-month period, prompting the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to declare the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security on 13th August 2024. The World Health Organization issued guidance for Mpox prevention in schools, where teachers are expected to support infection prevention.

pmc-13568353.title: Dynamic Imine-Linked NIPU with Shape Memory, Self-Healing, and Prospects for Recyclability
pmc-13568353.creator: Kshitij S. Shinde, Muhammad Yasar Razzaq, Harald Rupp, Zviadi Katcharava, Wolfgang H. Binder, Anke Schadewald
pmc-13568353.description: Non-isocyanate polyurethanes (NIPUs) incorporating dynamic imine linkages were developed via UV-induced photopolymerization of methacrylated monomers. The system combines a non-isocyanate urethane (NIU) precursor derived from cyclic carbonate chemistry with an imine-containing (Vit) monomer obtained via Schiff base formation, enabling compositionally tunable networks with a high gel content (90–97 wt%) and thermal stability up to >190 °C.
